anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (13.21, 12.08, 15.7) which is concerning given the 8-core system.
AI module shows no recent learning cycles, opportunities generated, or adjustments made, indicating potential issues with AI functionality or configuration.
Trading metrics show zero active trades and zero profit/loss, suggesting the trading system may not be functioning as expected.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review AI module configuration and ensure it is properly integrated and functioning to generate trading opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and ensure they are correctly configured and capable of executing trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and mitigate the cause.
recommendations.rationale: Sustained high CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Audit the AI module to diagnose why it is not generating opportunities or making adjustments.
